status_summary: On 2025-08-06 Executive Order 14329 imposed an additional 25 percent duty on products of India, and Executive Order 14384 of 2026-02-06 eliminated it, effective 2026-02-07, as the two governments issued a joint statement on a framework for an interim trade agreement. The Quad foreign ministers met in New Delhi in May 2026 and agreed a Fiji port project, a critical minerals framework and an Indo-Pacific energy security initiative, with no leaders' summit scheduled. No South Asia strategy or Quad-Plus step was found, and the Pakistan element runs the other way: the administration hosted Pakistan's prime minister and army chief at the White House and the Export-Import Bank approved about $1.25 billion for the Reko Diq mining project in December 2025. The United States does not recognize the Taliban, and its contact has centered on detainee releases.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14329 imposed an additional 25 percent ad valorem duty on products of India under the Russia-related emergency.
US EXIM approved about $1.25 billion in financing for the Reko Diq copper and gold mining project in Pakistan. (month only; first of month used)

Executive Order 14384 eliminated the additional 25 percent duty on products of India, effective 2026-02-07; the United States and India issued a joint statement the same day on a framework for an interim trade agreement.
The Quad foreign ministers, meeting in New Delhi, agreed to build a port in Fiji, a critical minerals framework and an Indo-Pacific energy security initiative (meeting reported on this date).

title: Make India the Quad cornerstone, set a South Asia strategy, no normal ties with Taliban
uncertainties: The 2025-08-06 date for the India duty is taken from the text of EO 14384; EO 14329 itself was not opened. EO 14389 of 2026-02-20 also lists EO 14329 among the IEEPA tariff orders it ended, after the India duty had already been removed. The joint statement on the trade framework rests on an accounting firm alert, since the executive order mentions only defense and energy commitments. The Quad meeting is reported by Reuters via a trade news site, which gives the report date but not the meeting date. The September 2025 Quad leaders' summit status and the US-Pakistan trade terms were not confirmed. The Pakistan description rests on a think-tank report that gives no dates for the White House meetings. The Taliban finding rests on one newspaper report of prisoner talks; no Bagram proposal and no formal recognition were found. The National Security Strategy mentions India and the Quad, mentions Pakistan only as a party to a peace deal with India and does not mention Afghanistan. Judgment: the stage reflects the whole recommendation, with the Quad element partly advancing and the Pakistan element running opposite.
